title: normalized_policy_clause.json -- normalized policy clauses for one policy document v0.2
description: Produced by policy-pipeline. One file per policy document, array of every clause identified in it, normalized into standard fields (coverage type, payout conditions, exclusions, reduction conditions).

evidence_references.description: Every condition carries its OWN source location -- document_id/page/quote all required (strict_evidence_reference). A condition may not inherit its provenance from the clause or from structural context; cross-contract validation additionally verifies each quote appears verbatim on the cited page.

clause_id.description: Assigned by policy-pipeline in extraction order -- stable regardless of the source policy's own article/paragraph numbering.

coverage_type.description: The coverage this clause pertains to, as named in the policy. e.g. "뇌혈관질환진단비"

payout_conditions.description: Itemized. Empty array if the clause states no conditions beyond the base coverage trigger.

evidence_references.description: Clause-level source location (e.g. the clause heading/quote), independent of the per-condition references above -- document_id/page/quote all required (strict_evidence_reference), verified verbatim against the processed text by cross-contract validation.
